extracted.intended_audience: writers seeking literary-agent representation (authors preparing queries/manuscripts)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for querying and submitting manuscripts to a literary agency (Folio Literary Management). Covers submission method, agent-selection, manuscript readiness, and the types/genres the agency represents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please visit the Agents section of our website and read the bios of each of our individual agents to figure out which of us might be right for your project, and our individual submission preferences. Agents at Folio ONLY accept email queries. (See guidelines for details.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent selection / targeted submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Read agent bios to determine which individual agent is right for your project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visit the Agents section of our website and read the bios of each of our individual agents to figure out which of us might be right for your project, and our individual submission preferences. See website for appropriate agent to contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify agency-specific guidelines before submitting
rubrics_metrics.description: The Market List recommends you verify the query and/or submission guidelines for each literary agent and literary agency before sending a query or submitting your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review and verify the agency requirements for working with new or unpublished writers as well as their specific areas of interest. If you have recently submitted to this literary agency or have experience with a specific agent, please submit a comment below.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript/completion expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Most agencies require a completed manuscript prior to queries or submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm whether the agency or the specific agent accepts partials/proposals or requires a full, completed manuscript before querying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market types represented
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-fiction books, novels, short story collections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the broad formats the agency represents; ensure your project fits one of these market types before querying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted genres / subject areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepts: Animals, Art, Biography, Business, Child, Cooking, Crime, Equestrian, Erotica, Espionage, Fantasy, Health/Fitness, History, How-To, Humor, Lifestyle, Literary, Memoirs, Military, Mystery, Narrative Non-Fiction, Nature, Popular Culture, Psychology, Relationship, Religion, Romance, Science, Self-Help, Southern, Women's
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match your manuscript's genre/subject to the agency's stated areas of interest; consult individual agent bios for finer-grained preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contacting the agency
rubrics_metrics.description: See website for appropriate agent to contact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the agency website to identify and contact the correct agent; agents will have individual submission preferences and contact details on the site.
